headline: Sensex slumps 1,000 points and Nifty falls below 25,600 as market reverses early gains amid sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Global market sell-off and profit booking after an initial higher open driven by foreign inflows.
Drag in metal and banking shares.
Spike in volatility with India VIX jumping nearly 8%.
Depreciation of the Rupee beyond 93 per US dollar.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled over 1,000 points from opening highs, pushing Nifty below 25,600.
Investors suffered market wealth losses between Rs 3 lakh crore and Rs 4.65 lakh crore.
APL Apollo stock dropped 18% following news of a Rs 15,510 crore stake sale plan.
Tata Steel shares dropped nearly 5% during the session.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened higher but quickly reversed gains to experience a sharp crash today, with Sensex sliding over 1,000 points. The decline erased up to Rs 4.65 lakh crore of investor wealth, dragged down by profit booking, global sell-offs, and weakness in banking and metal stocks. Stock-specific pressure was evident in APL Apollo and Tata Steel, which registered steep losses.
